confidence_rationale: Step 11's MEDIUM row: two requirement ids (REQ-029, and the cross-reference to REQ-010) required judgment to place at one artefact set rather than being read off a single unambiguous field on the step -- Q13's deferral and D5's two-answer citation (Q13, Q80) both had to be read together to write one requirement sentence. Not LOW: no row was written with an empty source_req_id or an empty verification cell, the step's test results were fully readable, and re-running this pass would replace the same rows rather than duplicate them. Not HIGH: the manifest-form divergence (CWB-SHARE-002 gap 1) and the Billing-mechanism reconciliation (O-M2S05-01) are both named as open rather than resolved.

process_observations.observation: The step's build-scope check_sharing_model.py test resolved exactly what B01's v4 rewrite predicted it would: 1 object OWD from M1-S01 plus this step's grant, 0 findings, closing the vacuous step-scope reading the same command gives at 0 OWDs resolved.

The RecordTypeId bare-developer-name value format the builder flagged as this step's most likely mock-deploy failure validated cleanly in reports/MOCK-DEPLOY-M2.md Run 3 (32/32 components, 0 errors), closing an UNVERIFIED marker the library itself carried.

Billing's access to its own cases (queue ownership, M2-S04) and Tier 1's exclusion from Billing cases (the absence of a sharing rule, this step) are served by two different mechanisms across two different steps, and no artefact or decision in plan.json states that the two are meant to compose into the requirement's whole Billing-visibility answer.

REQ-010 (M1-S01's OWD row) and CWB-SHARE-001 both state that the build-scope check_sharing_model.py assertion 'has not run'; it ran and passed in this pass, but agents/build-doc-keeper/AGENT.md Step 8 restricts this run to M2-S05's own rows, so the stale sentences were recorded as a correction (O-M2S05-02) rather than edited in place.
M2's five steps (M2-S01 through M2-S05) are all now documented; the milestone has not yet been cross-checked.
